papers.title: In-Context World Modeling for Robotic Control
papers.abstract: Framework enabling robot policies to infer system variables from self-generated interactions, allowing adaptation to novel configurations without parameter updates by treating system identification as an in-context adaptation problem.

papers.title: The Verification Horizon: No Silver Bullet for Coding Agent Rewards
papers.abstract: Challenges in coding agent verification arise from difficulty aligning proxy signals with human intent, requiring adaptive verification systems that evolve alongside generative capabilities across different task types.

papers.title: JetSpec: Breaking the Scaling Ceiling of Speculative Decoding with Parallel Tree Drafting
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding framework combining efficient forward drafting with causal conditioning to improve LLM inference speed and acceptance rates, achieving up to 9.64x speedup on mathematical benchmarks.

papers.title: GUI vs. CLI: Execution Bottlenecks in Screen-Only and Skill-Mediated Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract: Matched benchmark comparing graphical and command-line agent interfaces reveals different execution bottlenecks: GUI agents struggle with long-horizon grounded interaction, CLI agents with skill coverage.

papers.title: Why Multi-Step Tool-Use Reinforcement Learning Collapses and How Supervisory Signals Fix It
papers.abstract: Investigates how supervisory signals and interleaved training strategies improve stability in tool-use tasks, addressing catastrophic collapse through diverse guidance mechanisms and format-aware learning.

papers.title: LISA: Likelihood Score Alignment for Visual-condition Controllable Generation
papers.abstract: Regularization method aligning intermediate features with likelihood scores accelerates training convergence and improves synthetic results in visual-condition controllable generation tasks.

papers.title: Information-Aware KV Cache Compression for Long Reasoning
papers.abstract: Entropy-aware KV cache compression framework enhancing long-context reasoning in LLMs by incorporating information-theoretic signals alongside attention weights.

papers.title: Confidence-Aware Tool Orchestration for Robust Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Framework integrating per-frame trustworthiness into video reasoning to address the Blind Trust Problem under realistic perturbations like motion blur and occlusion.

papers.title: Hallucination in World Models is Predictable and Preventable
papers.abstract: World models exhibit hallucinations in low-data regions, detectable through data-centric signals and mitigatable using coverage-aware sampling techniques for efficient fine-tuning.

papers.title: CoffeeBench: Benchmarking Long-Horizon LLM Agents in Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Economies
papers.abstract: Evaluates LLM agents in a multi-agent economic simulation where firms interact over 90 days, revealing performance differences and communication patterns among various models.

cc_updates.body: Added CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS to disable mouse click/drag/hover in fullscreen mode while keeping wheel scroll. Fixed hook matchers with hyphenated identifiers accidentally substring-matching. Fixed voice dictation on macOS capturing silence in long-running sessions. Fixed voice dictation auto-submit never firing for languages written without spaces (Japanese, Chinese, Thai). Fixed external plugins not requiring explicit install consent on every loader path. Fixed /plugin Enable/Disable not working when a plugin's name differs from its marketplace entry name.

Added autoMode.classifyAllShell setting to route all Bash/PowerShell commands through the auto-mode classifier. Added auto-mode denial reasons to the transcript and /permissions recent denials. Added claude_code.assistant_response OpenTelemetry log event. Added live file path autocomplete to bash mode. Added a startup notice when MCP servers need authentication. Added automatic memory-pressure reaping for idle background shell commands.

Added /rewind support for resuming a conversation from before /clear was run. Fixed scroll position jumping to the bottom while reading earlier output during streaming. Fixed background agents resurrecting after being stopped. Fixed /voice showing a generic message when disabled by policy. Fixed /login URL opening truncated in Windows Terminal. Improved sandbox network permission dialog: hosts you allow with Yes are now remembered for the rest of the session.
